subject.why: The boots are clearly recognizable as tall black pirate boots with cuffs and prominent gold buckles.

category.why: The boots stand on a flat, plain surface with a smooth single-color gradient wall in the same pink color family.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermark, frame, or character present.

framing.why: The boots form a chunky, centered silhouette with generous margins on all sides.

colour.why: The warm pink background is vibrant and saturated, providing excellent contrast against the dark boots and shiny gold buckles.

detail.why: There are no micro-details, clutter, or unrequested props; the forms and folds are simple and clean.

style.why: The smooth chunky 3D volumes, satin sheen, and gold finish closely match the reference style.

bg_colour.why: background is pink (89% of the background); planned pink
